title: Implement AgentHarnessRun lifecycle, provider-neutral adapter boundary, and budgets
verify: AgentHarnessRun resolves ActorContext and Plant/Farm scope before model calls.
Budget exhaustion stops with clear status and next safe action.
evidence_required: Lifecycle tests for context_built, model_called, proposal_received, finalized, stopped, and failed states.
Provider unavailable and missing-provider-config tests proving no fake successful output.
constraints: The model never executes tools directly.
Missing provider configuration fails clearly and cannot silently fall back to fake product-agent output.
invariants: Harness owns model calls, context updates, traces, evals, budgets, and stop conditions.
Runtime/demo product agents cannot use fake, mock, hardcoded, or stubbed outputs as MVP acceptance.
